thesis.v: Former Carter Bank & Trust branch on a signalized corner of 5th Street SW — 0.90 ac with a 3,024 SF building and an intact drive-thru, close to I-64 and the 5th Street Station retail node (Wegmans). Goodwill is assessing this alongside its Pantops expansion search and specifically wants 5th Street traffic counts compared against its existing Avon Street/Mill Creek store before going further. No financing model or development scenario has been built for this site yet — this card is basic property information only, per Ben's 8/19 request.
